name: The New Phonics
author: Tronzeki
description: At 70%, time the blue orb before the teleport portal to stay as a ball. Move to the ceiling at 75%, click the yellow orb early at 78%, then click the blue orbs after it in the middle to be able to buffer back to the ceiling. Click before the pink orb at 83% to skip the wave portal. Free to the end from there.
